tokyo-kanto-rides-ashinoko-skyline-short.story: A proper escape from Tokyo with roads worth waking up for. 536 km round from Sakado - plan on about 9 h 45 of riding. On the way it passes Tanashichō and Tateyama. The climbs: near Narutō, Scenic stretch near Mobara and near Chichibu. It tops out at about 850 m. The line favours views over speed.

tokyo-kanto-rides-ashinoko-skyline-short.speedBand: 50–80 km/h riding core, local limits always win

sections.advice: Photo stop near Narutō → Scenic stretch near Mobara can flow quickly, but only if you keep village limits and junction sightlines sacred. Fast connectors are where rides get untidy when fatigue creeps in.

Scenic stretch near Mobara → Tateyama is the technical section. Hairpins, gradients and mixed traffic can stack up quickly; use low drama inputs, stay wide of centre lines and expect buses or riders appearing exactly where optimism says they will not.

Food stop near Fujiyoshida → High point near Chichibu is the logistics leg. Watch junctions, villages and speed changes, then let the roadbook do its job: move you out of the clutter without spending your best attention too early.

This High point near Chichibu → Back to Ashinoko Skyline stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

safetyMarkers.note: Respect posted limits and assume enforcement near villages, viewpoints and main-road joins.
A line-crossing or merge area where relaxed sightseeing traffic can behave unpredictably.
Watch shade, leaves, gravel wash and damp patches; conditions decide the pace.
